teachingNote: Normal speed; the bobblehead streaks in over 5 frames with a light sideways blur, lands sharp, crosses its arms, then streaks out in 2 frames.

receipt.construction: DreamCut demo project tpl-speed-entrance-bobblehead-demo, proposal 20261027T075309-12798cff (pending, not approved), rendered from the proposal preview with the production browser GPU compositor at 1920x1080 (scripts/render-preview.ts), scaled to 1280x720 H.264 (CRF 23, no audio). Stills over the empty-set still: walking pose 0.4-1.0 s keyed media_offset_x -2 -> 0 over 0.2 s (linear) with directional_blur_x 20 held until the last frame before landing; arms-crossed pose 1.0-4.0 s; walking pose 4.0-4.6 s holds 0.12 s, then media_offset_x 0 -> 2 over 0.08 s (easeIn) with directional_blur_x 0 -> 20. The prepared-input thumbnail is the walking pose with a sideways box blur drawn by ffmpeg for illustration. Poster frame 14; stages frames 5, 13, 60 and 104.
